title: 谓词下推的两个反例：nondeterministic 谓词与列不在投影内
code:
def Scan(name, cols, rows=0):
    return {"op": "Scan", "name": name, "cols": list(cols), "rows": rows, "children": []}


def Project(cols, child):
    return {"op": "Project", "cols": list(cols), "children": [child]}


def Join(cond, left, right):
    return {"op": "Join", "cond": cond, "children": [left, right]}


def cols_out(n):
    if n["op"] in ("Scan", "Project"):
        return set(n["cols"])
    s = set()
    for c in n["children"]:
        s |= cols_out(c)
    return s


def can_push(f, child):
    """返回 (是否可下推, 原因)。两条硬约束：谓词必须确定性；引用列必须在下方输出内。"""
    if not f["det"]:
        return False, "谓词非确定性（含 rand()/current_timestamp()），下推会改变每行求值次数与语义"
    missing = sorted(set(f["refs"]) - cols_out(child))
    if missing:
        return False, "谓词引用列 " + str(missing) + " 不在下方算子的输出列中"
    return True, "谓词确定性 且 引用列 " + str(sorted(f["refs"])) + " 可由下方算子提供"


cases = []

# 用例1：nondeterministic 谓词，不可下推
u1_child = Join("o.uid=u.uid", Scan("orders", ["uid", "amount"]), Scan("users", ["uid", "city"]))
cases.append(("Filter(rand() < 0.1)",
              {"pred": "rand() < 0.1", "refs": ["rnd"], "det": False}, u1_child))

# 用例2：谓词引用的列不在 Project 输出内，不可下推
u2_child = Project(["dept", "city"], Scan("orders", ["uid", "dept", "city", "salary"]))
cases.append(("Filter(salary > 100)",
              {"pred": "salary > 100", "refs": ["salary"], "det": True}, u2_child))

# 用例3（对照）：确定性且列在投影内，可下推
u3_child = Project(["dept", "city"], Scan("orders", ["uid", "dept", "city", "salary"]))
cases.append(("Filter(city = 'bj')",
              {"pred": "city = 'bj'", "refs": ["city"], "det": True}, u3_child))

judge = []
for i, (name, f, child) in enumerate(cases, 1):
    ok, reason = can_push(f, child)
    judge.append(ok)
    print("[用例" + str(i) + "] " + name + "  下推到 " + child["op"] + " 之下")
    print("  可下推: " + str(ok))
    print("  原因: " + reason)
    print("  下方算子的输出列: " + str(sorted(cols_out(child))))

print("")
print("判定汇总 = " + str(judge))
print("判据 用例1 不可下推（nondeterministic）: " + str(judge[0] is False))
print("判据 用例2 不可下推（列不在投影内）: " + str(judge[1] is False))
print("判据 用例3 可下推（对照组）: " + str(judge[2] is True))
expected_output:
[用例1] Filter(rand() < 0.1)  下推到 Join 之下
  可下推: False
  原因: 谓词非确定性（含 rand()/current_timestamp()），下推会改变每行求值次数与语义
  下方算子的输出列: ['amount', 'city', 'uid']
[用例2] Filter(salary > 100)  下推到 Project 之下
  可下推: False
  原因: 谓词引用列 ['salary'] 不在下方算子的输出列中
  下方算子的输出列: ['city', 'dept']
[用例3] Filter(city = 'bj')  下推到 Project 之下
  可下推: True
  原因: 谓词确定性 且 引用列 ['city'] 可由下方算子提供
  下方算子的输出列: ['city', 'dept']

判定汇总 = [False, False, True]
判据 用例1 不可下推（nondeterministic）: True
判据 用例2 不可下推（列不在投影内）: True
判据 用例3 可下推（对照组）: True
